title: Private KMS/HSM Terraform module with secrets migration and continuous prober
creator: Ananya Rao
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that automates integration between cloud KMS providers and on-prem HSMs (CloudHSM/PKCS#11 proxies), provides idempotent secrets migration from cloud Secrets Manager into Vault, and deploys a lightweight continuous prober in the VPC to validate KMS/HSM health and secrets availability. Module should work for AWS and hybrid on-prem use cases and emit metrics to Redwood monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Terraform module exposes providers for AWS KMS, CloudHSM, and a PKCS#11 HSM proxy; 2) Secrets migration plan (dry-run) from Secrets Manager to Vault can be executed with no downtime for reads; 3) Prober daemon is deployable to a private subnet ASG and emits Prometheus metrics (kms.key_status, kms.latency_ms, secrets.sync_errors) to our metrics relay; 4) Module has automated key rotation workflow that supports staged rewrap and rollback; 5) Terratest integration validates idempotency and failure scenarios in CI; 6) Security review signed off and docs published.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Kickoff: scoped module to cover AWS KMS + CloudHSM + generic PKCS11-proxy for on-prem HSMs. Decided to keep Vault as canonical secrets backend rather than a dual-write model; migration will be cutover-first (read-through) then final cutover.

2025-02-25 - Decision: use an operator pattern for staged key rewraps (control plane runs rewrap job via vault API) rather than attempting live re-encryption in Terraform. Trade-off: additional runtime component but safer for large key sets.

2025-02-28 - Blocker discovered: existing Terraform state for some customers stores raw ARNs in module outputs. Plan: add a state-translation helper and pre-flight report to surface required manual changes before migration. Filed follow-up ticket ENG-40615.
2025-03-03 - PR opened with module scaffold and prober container: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/PR-1723. Requesting review from @james-ops and @sara-sec.

2025-03-05 - Infra review notes: enforce least-privilege IAM, add kms:DescribeKey to prober role, require audit logging for key operations. Added tests for simulated CloudHSM failover in Terratest harness.
testing_plan: Write Terratest suites that: (a) validate plan/apply/idempotency against a disposable account; (b) simulate CloudHSM partition by revoking network access to HSM endpoints and assert prober metrics; (c) run migration dry-run and verify Vault contains expected secrets and ACLs; (d) smoke test rotation operator with a single test key and validate consumer read continuity.
rollback_plan: 1) If migration fails mid-run, prober will flag failed paths and the module exposes a migration checkpoint file; 2) Stop migration operator and revert consumers to read from Secrets Manager using the previously preserved mapping; 3) Revoke any intermediate keys created during failed rewraps and restore previous key policy attachments; 4) Postmortem and automated cleanup runbook stored in ops-playbooks repository.
notes: Aim for minimal surface area in module API: inputs for provider configs, key mapping file, migration strategy (dry-run | live-cutover), prober config (interval, timeout), and optional rotation operator toggle. Keep sensitive material out of state by using data sources where possible and relying on Vault for secret storage. Coordinate with PM for customers that have dedicated CloudHSM clusters since migration windows may be constrained.
